name: MOGO Research V1
description: Default Phase 1 priority weighting (PROGRAM-004 Owner Decision 8). Prioritizes objective strategy-rule extraction, resolving unresolved strategy questions (ADR-007-style gaps), understanding why trades win or fail, replay/paper-trading learning value, chart evidence, risk-management relevance, high-authority primary sources, and novelty relative to existing research. Penalizes promotional/lifestyle/generic-motivation content, exact duplicates, and low-authority secondary summaries with little actionable trading information -- without ever coercing an unassessed penalty dimension to zero.
